LucioCrossfadePartyMixQuest.name: Party Mix
LucioCrossfadePartyMixQuest.description: Quest: Play Lúcio's Crossfade tracks to nearby allies. Multiple allies provide additional time. Reward: For every 1 Minute played, permanently increase Lucio's maximum Mana by 10. Reward: Once you have played for 8 minutes or more, permanently increase Crossfade's range by 20%.

LucioWallRideAccelerando.name: Accelerando
LucioWallRideAccelerando.description: Wall Ride's Movement Speed bonus gradually increases to 40% over 4 seconds while Lúcio maintains its effect.

LucioPassiveSmoothMoves.name: Smooth Moves
LucioPassiveSmoothMoves.description: While Wall Ride is active, Basic Attacks heal for 30% of the damage dealt and restore 0.5 Mana. Passive: Increase Wall Ride duration by 1 second.

LucioSoundwaveSubwoofer.name: Subwoofer
LucioSoundwaveSubwoofer.description: Enemies within the first half of Soundwave's range are knocked back 75% further. Quest: Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single Soundwave. Reward: Increase Soundwave's arc by 50% and its range by 20%.

LucioSoundwaveOffTheWall.name: Off the Wall
LucioSoundwaveOffTheWall.description: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave while Wall Ride is active reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

LucioPushOffSupersonic.name: Supersonic
LucioPushOffSupersonic.description: While Wall Ride is active, Push Off's cooldown recharges 100% faster.

LucioSoundwaveGoodVibrations.name: Good Vibrations
LucioSoundwaveGoodVibrations.description: Hitting an enemy with Soundwave grants Lúcio a 38 (+4% per level) Shield for 7 seconds. Hitting enemy Heroes grants 3 times this amount.

LucioReverseAmp.name: Reverse Amp
LucioReverseAmp.description: Blast Lúcio's active Crossfade track at enemy Heroes. While Amp It Up is active, Healing Boost deals 50 (+4% per level) damage per second and Speed Boost Slows by 20%. This ability is unaffected by Crossfade talents.

LucioBoombox.name: Boombox
LucioBoombox.description: Place a boombox that plays Lúcio's active Crossfade track. Its volume adjusts with Amp It Up. Allied Heroes near the boombox gain 5 Armor. Crossfade tracks do not stack.

LucioSoundBarrier.name: Sound Barrier
LucioSoundBarrier.description: After 1 second, Lúcio and nearby allied Heroes gain a 1296 (+4% per level) point Shield that rapidly decays over 6 seconds.

LucioHighFive.name: High Five
LucioHighFive.description: Quickly skate to an allied Hero. Upon arrival the ally is healed for 230 (+4% per level), Lúcio is healed for 80 (+4% per level), and both gain Unstoppable for 1 second.

LucioCrossfadeAllTogetherTalent.name: All Together
LucioCrossfadeAllTogetherTalent.description: For each ally affected by Crossfade, Lúcio gains 5% Movement Speed that stacks with other bonuses.

LucioPushOffHeavyCasters.name: Heavy Casters
LucioPushOffHeavyCasters.description: Push Off no longer Slows enemies, and instead Stuns them for 0.5 seconds.

LucioWallRideSlip.name: Slip
LucioWallRideSlip.description: While Wall Ride is active, passing near an enemy Hero increases its Movement Speed bonus to 40%, and grants 15 Armor, for 1 second.

LucioAmpItUpRejuvenescencia.name: Rejuvenescência
LucioAmpItUpRejuvenescencia.description: While Amp It Up is active, Crossfade's Healing Boost heals for an additional 2.5% of the target's maximum Health each second.

LucioAmpItUpUpTheFrequency.name: Up the Frequency
LucioAmpItUpUpTheFrequency.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks reduces the cooldown of Amp It Up by 0.4 seconds. Passive: Wall Ride increases Basic Attack range by 2.2.

LucioAmpItUpUpToEleven.name: Up To Eleven
LucioAmpItUpUpToEleven.description: Increase the duration of Amp It Up by 1 second. While Amp It Up is active, enemy Heroes hit by Soundwave or Push-Off further increase its duration by 0.3 seconds.

LucioSoundBarrierBossaNova.name: Bossa Nova
LucioSoundBarrierBossaNova.description: Reduce the cooldown of Sound Barrier to 30 seconds, but the Shield now decays over 4 seconds.

LucioCrossfadeMixingFire.name: Mixing Fire
LucioCrossfadeMixingFire.description: High Five can now be cast on enemy Heroes, dealing 160 (+4% per level) damage and reducing all healing received by 50% for 3 seconds. Passive: Reduce the cost and cooldown of High Five by 30%.

LucioPassiveHouseParty.name: House Party
LucioPassiveHouseParty.description: For each ally affected by Crossfade, Lúcio gains 8% increased healing.

LucioItemSummerAnthem.name: Summer Anthem
LucioItemSummerAnthem.description: Activate for allies affected by Crossfade to become Unkillable for 1.5 seconds.
